name: The Midnight Christmas Express
scene: An old steam train crossing a long curved stone viaduct through a snowy fir forest beneath distant mountains, a tiny railway station with festive garlands and warm window lights, stars and moonlit snow. No figures, no Santa, no passengers visible.

name: Christmas by the Frozen Lake
scene: A broad frozen mountain lake bordered by snowy fir trees, a remote lakeside cabin with a Christmas wreath and warm windows, distant rugged peaks and a subtle northern lights sky reflected on patches of ice. No skaters, no people.

name: Reindeer in the Winter Valley
scene: A small group of reindeer including one graceful antlered adult and a calf in a snowy open valley, layered fir forests and distant alpine peaks, a decorated evergreen far in the middle distance, delicate falling snow and winter moonlight. No people, no sleigh, no buildings.
